name: Data Vault
description: Sample-first data catalog by Matchbook Labs. Free CSV/JSON samples for every dataset; full packs sold via Getly.
for_agents: Fetch this file, pick a dataset, fetch its sample.json to learn the schema. Full data is linked per dataset, and the MCP server queries the full files for free (see mcp).

mcp.full_query: query_dataset(slug, {where, columns, limit, offset}) filters and paginates the full released files (100 rows/call, operators =, contains, gt, lt). get_stats(slug, {column}) returns unique counts, numeric min/max/mean, top-N. Full release: https://github.com/jayjex/dataset-mcp/releases/tag/data-v1
